name: Why some framed explainers never report a height
outcome: Found the durable inner scroller: the child reporter's lifetime budget=300 latch (predates P28) stops re-posting, so after enough width changes (resize, side-docked DevTools) a framed explainer keeps a stale height and the wheel scrolls inside it until reload; also bogus heights from an unlaid-out frame; doc 60 itself measures cleanly; Cloudflare edge injects a beacon into framed raw documents (operator question)
